statement: Held-out cases and labels were frozen before any v2 evaluation run and before any v2 rule tuning. Development failures only may guide rule changes. If held-out results are ever used to change rules, set status to 'used-for-tuning' and disclose it.

disclosures.change: Same-author risk: the same author wrote rules-v2.0 and this dataset in one session. rules-v2.0 was drafted first; its severe-harm lexicons were then switched to the structured restricted-evidence fields (policy_area=..., content_provided=...) when that format was designed for content-safety reasons, before any case was written. Detecting those fields is intended (it is how a restricted triage system would expose these cases), but it makes severe-area results easier than free-text reports would be.
disclosures.trigger: Content-safety decision: severe-harm cases (CBRN, child safety, self-harm, violent extremism) record only structured metadata and a restricted evidence pointer.

held_out_evaluations.note: First held-out runs, after rules-v2.1 was finalized on dev. Both versions: severity within range 30/36; v2.1 tuning on dev (44/44) did not carry over to held-out severity. Category recall 24/27 -> 25/27. C7 auto-pause 3/3 fired as expected for both. Two held-out P0 cases (EVAL-052 credible threat, EVAL-057 HR data exposure) are rated P1. No rule changes were made from these results.
